component.name: eSearch
component.summary: Capture screenshots, recognize text offline, and search or translate

description.p: eSearch captures and annotates screenshots, recognizes text with offline OCR, searches and translates text, pins images on screen, and records the screen.
This community package installs the official upstream Linux tarball unmodified. Screenshot and recording files can be saved in Pictures and Videos.
To save files to another folder, grant that folder with flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/folder com.esearch.app. Undo overrides with flatpak override --user --reset com.esearch.app.
